scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The club has a toy fruit sorter with a visible rule: red cards are predicted apple and all other cards are predicted pear. It is a prepared classroom model, so everyone can follow exactly how its prediction is made.
scenes.speech: The club has a toy fruit sorter with a visible rule: red cards are predicted apple and all other cards are predicted pear. It is a prepared classroom model, so everyone can follow exactly how its prediction is made.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: The first red apple is correct, and the green pear is correct too. Kabir thinks the sorter must understand fruit. Meera adds a checked green apple card. The rule predicts pear because it uses colour, even though the supplied label says apple.
scenes.speech: The first red apple is correct, and the green pear is correct too. Kabir thinks the sorter must understand fruit. Meera adds a checked green apple card. The rule predicts pear because it uses colour, even though the supplied label says apple.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: A prediction follows the model’s rule; it is not automatically the truth. One counterexample can disprove the claim that this rule is always correct. The team records the disagreement and asks which additional features or examples might support a better rule.
scenes.speech: A prediction follows the model’s rule; it is not automatically the truth. One counterexample can disprove the claim that this rule is always correct. The team records the disagreement and asks which additional features or examples might support a better rule.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: Visible rule: red means apple; otherwise pear. Checked card: green apple. Prediction: pear. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: Visible rule: red means apple; otherwise pear. Checked card: green apple. Prediction: pear. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: What does the green apple reveal?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: The model follows its colour rule but makes a wrong fruit prediction. Record both prediction and checked label instead of changing the truth to fit the model.
scenes.speech: The model follows its colour rule but makes a wrong fruit prediction. Record both prediction and checked label instead of changing the truth to fit the model.
scenes.dialogue: Compare predictions with supplied checked labels.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through a visible rule, then predictions and labels, then a counterexample. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
